auth_account_delete_cleanup_explanation: Authentication ends immediately when deletion is accepted. The items below are the cleanup scope; native, shared and external cleanup can remain pending. A deleted account cannot be restored.
auth_account_delete_cleanup_pending: Authentication has ended. Cleanup of native, shared and external copies is still pending; this is not confirmation of complete erasure.
auth_account_delete_confirmation_error: Type the confirmation phrase shown above.
auth_account_delete_denied: This account cannot be deleted yet. Complete the items listed above first. A prerequisite may still be unresolved, or current permission may be missing. This response does not identify a specific prerequisite.
auth_account_delete_description: This permanently deletes your REZICS account, signs you out everywhere, and cannot be undone.
auth_account_delete_erased_collections: Your private, unlisted and deleted Collections.
auth_account_delete_erased_library: Your whole library: shelf entries, reading progress and history, copies and follows.
auth_account_delete_erased_profile: Your profile, name, handle and avatar.
auth_account_delete_finality: Deletion is final and cannot be undone.
auth_account_delete_no_automated_account: Before deletion, ensure that no automated accounts are operated by this account.
auth_account_delete_no_pending_transfer: Before deletion, ensure that no transfer is pending.
auth_account_delete_not_last_owner: Before deletion, ensure that you are not the last owner of any organization.
auth_account_delete_ownership_navigation: Appoint another owner from the organization’s member management page, available through the website’s managed accounts settings.
auth_account_delete_prepare: If you do not want something to stay, make the Collection private or delete the post first.
auth_account_delete_prerequisites_descri: Resolve these prerequisites before deletion. These are requirements, not verified results. The lists below do not establish whether you can delete this account.
auth_account_delete_prerequisites_headin: Before you can delete this account
auth_account_delete_privacy_contact: To get a copy of your data, before or after deletion, contact {contact}.
auth_account_delete_retained_attribution: These contributions remain attributed to “Deleted account”, frozen and no longer editable by anyone. No replacement curator is assigned.
auth_account_delete_retained_collections: Your public Collections as they are now, with their current notes.
auth_account_delete_security_description: This permanently deletes your REZICS account and signs you out everywhere.
auth_account_delete_unavailable: Account deletion is unavailable right now.
auth_account_operation_failure: The request could not be completed. Please try again.
auth_account_operation_leave_notice: Leaving does not undo a submitted operation or resolve an unknown result. Return to this operation to review its result before starting another request.
auth_account_operation_reconfirm: Your identity was verified. Review the request and confirm again. No action has been executed by returning here.
auth_account_operation_sign_in_required: You are signed out. Sign in to manage your account.
auth_account_operation_unavailable: A required service is unavailable. No success is confirmed. Retry later.
auth_account_operation_unknown: The result is unknown. The operation may have taken effect. Retry the same request; do not start a duplicate. If signed out, that alone does not confirm deletion.
auth_consent_approved: Access approved. You can return to the client.
auth_consent_approved_none: No permissions were added. Existing access remains unchanged.
auth_consent_declined: Review declined. This choice sends no approval.
auth_consent_declined_after_submission: Review declined. An earlier approval may still have taken effect.
auth_consent_scope_offline_access: Keep access when you are away
auth_consent_sign_in_required: Sign in to review this request.
auth_consent_stale_review: The requested access or current permissions changed. Review the updated details and make a new decision.
auth_consent_submission_unknown: The approval result for this account is unknown and may have taken effect. A later permission read cannot resolve it.
auth_consent_unattributed_submission: An earlier submission for this client and request is unresolved. It may have been made by another account; this review cannot identify who submitted it.
auth_failure_rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
auth_failure_retry_after: Too many requests. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth_failure_unavailable: Sign-in and recovery are temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
auth_home_intro: Find a task, learn what to prepare and open its current review page.
auth_home_identity_ready: This is the account returned by the latest check.
auth_home_identity_missing_email: No email address is available for this account.
auth_home_identity_denied: Access to private account details was refused. Those details are hidden.
auth_home_identity_unavailable: Account details are unavailable. Your sign-in status is unknown.
auth_home_settings_description: Each destination checks its own current native guidance and may require authentication. A link opens review; it does not promise an action is available. Availability is unknown on this home.
auth_home_security_description: Review passwords, passkeys and sessions in Security. Current authentication and additional verification may be required before a change.
auth_home_rename_description: Prepare the handle you want to use. The rename page checks current requirements and asks you to review and confirm the change.
auth_home_delete_description: Destructive change: review requirements and consequences before deliberate confirmation. An accepted request does not prove all retained records or copies have been erased.
auth_home_signed_out_description: Sign in, create an account, or recover access.
auth_connected_operation_acknowledged: The permission change was acknowledged. Review current permissions separately.
auth_connected_operation_dispatched: A permission change was sent, but its result is not confirmed. Sign in and review current permissions; that does not confirm the earlier change.
auth_connected_operation_refused: The permission change was refused. Review current permissions before deciding again.
auth_connected_operation_unknown: The permission change result is unknown. Sign in and review current permissions separately; this will not confirm the earlier change.
auth_connected_operation_unsent: No permission change was sent. Review current permissions before deciding again.
auth_inventory_choose_removals: Remove permissions you no longer want this application to have. Cancel to discard this selection.
auth_inventory_clients_description: These applications are your responsibility. Their registered permissions do not grant you access.
auth_inventory_clients_empty: You do not own any applications.
auth_inventory_consents_description: These grants let applications act for you. A grant does not mean you own the application.
auth_inventory_consents_empty: You have not granted any application permissions.
auth_inventory_denied: Access was refused. No change is confirmed.
auth_inventory_expired: This page has expired or your session changed. Reload the list.
auth_inventory_preflight: This list does not confirm deletion eligibility. Resolve application ownership and other responsibilities first; deletion checks them again.
auth_inventory_reduce_confirm: Reduce permissions for {name}? The permissions listed below will be removed. This also signs you out of your sessions.
auth_inventory_reduced: Access was reduced and your sessions were invalidated. Sign in again to see current permissions.
auth_inventory_remove_confirm: Remove access for {name}? This also signs you out of your sessions.
auth_inventory_unavailable: This list is unavailable. Your responsibilities and permissions are unknown.
auth_inventory_unknown: The result is unknown. Sign in again and reload before making another change.
auth_locale_pending: Current language: {language}. Apply to change the interface without leaving this page.
auth_locale_temporary: Language changed for this document. Your browser did not remember the choice.
auth_locale_unsupported: This language is unavailable. Choose one from the list.
auth_login_departure_description: Your entered credentials will be cleared. Leaving cannot cancel a sign-in already sent to the server.
auth_login_invalid_credentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth_login_page_unavailable: Sign-in choices could not be loaded. Try again.
auth_login_passkey_browser_unsupported: Passkey sign-in is not supported by this browser. Use your password instead.
auth_login_passkey_method_unavailable: Passkey sign-in is unavailable here. Use your password instead.
auth_login_pending_passkey: Waiting for passkey sign-in. Finish or cancel the prompt before choosing another method.
auth_login_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again later.
auth_login_recovery_success: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
auth_login_retry_after: Too many sign-in attempts. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.
auth_login_review_signed_out: You are now signed out. Choose a sign-in method to continue.
auth_login_reviewed: This is the current session. Choose whether to continue or use a different account.
auth_login_switching: You are signing in with a different account.
auth_login_unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
auth_login_uncertain: The sign-in outcome could not be confirmed. It may have completed. Review the current session before choosing your next step. A matching account does not confirm this attempt.
auth_login_viewer_changed: The signed-in account has changed. Review this account before continuing.
auth_members_departure: Leave this unfinished membership change? Unsent input will be discarded.
auth_members_acknowledged: The command was acknowledged. The list below is a separate current native read; acknowledgement does not establish final workflow completion.
auth_members_actions_unavailable: Actions are unavailable for this membership.
auth_members_inventory_unavailable: The member list is unavailable. Reload to try again.
auth_members_last_owner: This is the last owner. Native advice does not allow changing or removing this role.
auth_members_leave_unavailable: Leaving is unavailable for your current membership.
auth_members_authority: Native current membership, owner, surviving organization and responsibility rules decide whether the change is allowed. Resource grants are separate.
auth_members_confirm_check: I confirm this exact organization, member and effect.
auth_members_conflict: Membership changed or the command conflicts with native responsibility rules. Reload before continuing.
auth_members_denied: Current authority does not permit this request. No permission is inferred from this page.
auth_members_empty_page: No current holders were returned on this page.
auth_members_intro: Manage existing organization membership using your own current authority.
auth_members_no_reservation: The native source does not provide this membership’s reservation. Role changes and removal are unavailable.
auth_members_preparing: Membership is preparing. Reload the current list before continuing.
auth_members_recovery_review: Review current membership before seeing details or retrying this change. Nothing will be sent automatically.
auth_members_recovery_sign_in: Sign in as the person who started the change
auth_members_recovery_unavailable: Current membership advice is unavailable. The earlier result remains unknown.
auth_members_step_up: Sign in again as the original person, then review and submit the same change again.
auth_members_unavailable: Membership management is unavailable. No change is confirmed.
auth_members_unknown: The outcome is unknown. Keep this exact command for retry; the current list alone does not establish its outcome.
auth_organization_conflict: The organization could not be created. The handle may be taken.
auth_organization_creation_checking: Checking current organization creation advice. This check does not send a creation request.
auth_organization_creation_approving: Checking and approving your creation request. This approval does not confirm that an organization was created.
auth_organization_creation_sending: Your creation request was sent. Waiting for the native acknowledgement.
auth_organization_creation_unknown: The creation result is still unknown. The organization may have been created. Signing out or a later refusal does not settle this attempt.
auth_organization_delete_accepted: Organization deletion committed. Cleanup across data owners, shared copies and external copies may still be pending; complete erasure is not confirmed.
auth_organization_delete_changed: The account, organization or request changed. Review the current organization and confirm a new request.
auth_organization_delete_denied: The native deletion checks refused this request. Resolve ownership obligations, pending transfers and operated accounts before confirming again.
auth_organization_delete_effect: Deletion permanently closes this organization and cannot be undone. Native, shared and external cleanup can remain pending.
auth_organization_delete_read_denied: This organization is missing or you cannot currently manage it. No private summary or deletion is available.
auth_organization_delete_remedies: Resolve the organization’s ownership obligations, pending transfers and operated accounts first. Current native authority and responsibility checks decide whether deletion is allowed.
auth_organization_delete_still_readable: The organization is currently readable. The earlier command result remains unknown. Do not start another deletion.
auth_organization_delete_unknown: The deletion result is unknown and may have taken effect. Check the current organization; do not start another deletion. A missing organization or lost access alone does not confirm deletion.
auth_organization_explanation: An organization has no sign-in of its own. Creation requires your current permission and an open platform gate; you may be asked to verify your identity.
auth_organization_handle_invalid: Use 3 to 64 characters: letters a–z, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number.
auth_organization_departure_description: Your unsent review will be discarded.
auth_organization_delete_departure_descr: Your typed confirmation will be cleared if you leave.
auth_organization_not_open: This part of REZICS is not open yet.
auth_organization_refused: Creation was refused. Check your permission to create an organization and whether the handle is available.
auth_organization_return_acknowledged: This page received an acknowledgement for a creation before you left. Review current advice before starting another request.
auth_organization_return_unresumable: The earlier creation result is still unresolved. The original request no longer matches the current account or recovery data, so it cannot be resumed safely. Sign in to the account that began it or review Security. No new creation was sent.
auth_passkey_denied: That passkey was not accepted. Try again or use your password.
auth_permission_description_account_dele: Request permanent deletion of an account where you have deletion permission. Existing deletion requirements still apply.
auth_permission_description_account_mana: Request account management actions, including credentials, sessions and operated accounts, where you have management permission.
auth_permission_description_account_read: Request account details, preferences and account-related records that you are allowed to read.
auth_permission_description_account_upda: Request changes to account profiles, handles and preferences where you have permission.
auth_permission_description_limits: These descriptions explain requested capabilities, not whether an application is trustworthy. Account and resource permissions and current grants still limit access.
auth_permission_description_offline_acce: Let the application renew access without you being present, while its current authorization remains valid.
auth_permission_description_openid_detai: Let the application identify your REZICS account when you sign in.
auth_permission_description_organization: Request creation of an organization where creation is allowed.
auth_permission_description_subject_read: Request information about works and other catalogue subjects, within your current access.
auth_permission_description_unknown_deta: This page does not know what this permission allows. Check its exact identifier before deciding.
auth_recovery_start_unknown: The recovery request may have been accepted, but its result is unknown. This does not confirm that an account exists or that mail arrived. A later refusal cannot settle that earlier request.
auth_recovery_return_complete_unknown: The earlier password reset may have completed. Its result is unknown. Signing in or checking current advice cannot confirm what that reset did.
auth_recovery_return_complete_acknowledg: The earlier password reset was acknowledged. Sign in to continue.
auth_recovery_return_credentials_cleared: The email, recovery token and password were cleared. The original submission cannot be retried here. You can sign in or deliberately request a fresh recovery link.
auth_recovery_return_advice: Current recovery advice is ready. It describes available actions; it is not a receipt for earlier work.
auth_recovery_resend_confirmation: This sends a new request. The earlier request may still complete; mail delivery is not confirmed.
auth_recovery_departure_description: Leaving clears this recovery information. A request already sent may still finish.
auth_recovery_link_invalid: This recovery link is invalid or has expired.
auth_recovery_password_invalid: Password must be between 8 and 128 characters.
auth_recovery_start_success: Your recovery request was accepted. This does not confirm mail delivery or a password change.
auth_recovery_unknown: The result is unknown. Your password may already have changed. Try again with the original submission, or restart recovery. A later invalid link does not prove the change failed.
auth_recovery_consequences: A completed reset ends your existing sessions. Sign in again with your new password.
auth_rename_confirm: I confirm changing this account’s handle to @{handle}.
auth_rename_departure_unsent: Your proposed handle and confirmation will be cleared if you leave.
auth_rename_departure_pending: This rename was sent. Leaving will not cancel it or confirm its outcome. You can stay to review the current account.
auth_rename_conflict: The current handle changed, the requested handle is unavailable, or native approval refused the change. The current account has been reloaded. Review it and confirm again.
auth_rename_denied: Your current session cannot rename this account. No permission has been assumed.
auth_rename_description: Choose a new handle for your current account. Your account and its content keep the same identity.
auth_rename_forwarding: Your former handle forwards to this same account for 30 days. After that it stays reserved to your account and cannot be assigned to anyone else.
auth_rename_management_auth_required: Continue with the rename management session to review this account. Its current handle stays hidden until the native profile read is admitted.
auth_rename_management_returned: Your rename management session is confirmed. Review the current handle and confirm any change before submitting. Returning here did not submit a rename.
auth_rename_invalid: Enter a different handle using 3–64 letters, numbers, underscores or hyphens, with a letter or number at each end. Spaces are not allowed.
auth_rename_reconfirm: Review this saved change and explicitly confirm again. Returning from identity confirmation does not submit a rename.
auth_rename_retry: Confirm and retry the original rename
auth_rename_signed_out: Sign in to rename your own account.
auth_rename_unavailable: Account renaming is unavailable. We could not read or confirm your current account securely. Reload before trying again.
auth_rename_unknown: A rename was sent, but its outcome is still unknown. Reviewing the current account does not retry it.
auth_security_action_accepted: Auth accepted the action. This response does not verify the later security inventory.
auth_security_action_unknown: The action result is unknown. Check current security settings before trying again.
auth_security_action_unverified: Your session is no longer authorized. The action result has not been verified. Sign in to check current security settings.
auth_security_authority_changed: Your account or security authority changed. Sign in again to load current security settings.
auth_security_departure_description: Leaving clears private page data. A security operation already underway may still finish.
auth_security_passkey_add_failed: The passkey could not be added. Please try again.
auth_security_passkey_last_credential: You cannot remove your last way to sign in. Add a password or another passkey first.
auth_security_passkey_registration_revie: Current passkeys are shown below. The earlier registration is still unconfirmed. Review the list before continuing.
auth_security_passkey_registration_unkno: The registration response was lost or could not be confirmed. Your passkey may already be installed. Check current passkeys before continuing.
auth_security_passkey_remove_confirmatio: Remove this passkey? You will no longer be able to sign in with it. This signs you out of all sessions.
auth_security_passkey_remove_failed: The passkey could not be removed. Please try again later.
auth_security_passkeys_description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, screen lock or a security key instead of a password.
auth_security_passkeys_empty: You have not added a passkey yet.
auth_security_passkeys_failed: Your passkeys could not be loaded. Please try again later.
auth_security_password_approval_unknown: Auth did not confirm whether it issued approval. No password change is confirmed. This page keeps the same staged request; retry this exact step only while current Security advice allows it.
auth_security_password_apply_unknown: Auth did not confirm whether the password changed. The same apply request is kept on this page. Retry it only while current Security advice allows it; a refusal or sign-out cannot settle this result.
auth_security_password_return_stage: Staging may have been interrupted. Staging does not confirm that a password changed.
auth_security_password_return_approval: Staging was acknowledged, but approval may have been interrupted. Approval is not a password application.
auth_security_password_return_apply: Staging and approval were acknowledged, but password application may have been interrupted. Its outcome is unknown.
auth_security_password_return_applied_af: A password application was confirmed, but it does not settle a different earlier unknown result.
auth_security_password_return_readback: This current Security read is read-only. It cannot show whether a password exists or settle an earlier unknown application.
auth_security_password_return_acknowledg: I understand the earlier result is still unknown. Start a new password change.
auth_security_password_return_new_attemp: This is a new password change under current Security advice. It does not retry or settle the earlier operation.
auth_security_password_consequences: If this replaces an existing password, Auth signs out all sessions, including this one. If the account has no password yet, adding one keeps existing sessions active. If signed out, sign in with the new password; use account recovery if that does not work.
auth_security_password_failed: The password could not be changed. Please try again later.
auth_security_password_paused: The next step was not sent. This page still holds the original request and its confirmed progress.
auth_security_password_recovery_handoff: If this session ends, sign in with the new password. If sign-in fails, recover access to your account.
auth_security_password_refused: Auth refused this step and reported that it was not applied. No password change was confirmed. Check Security advice before starting a new review.
auth_security_password_review_invalidate: This review is no longer current. Review the password change again before submitting it.
auth_security_password_retry_expired: The approval has expired. A refusal now cannot tell whether an earlier apply changed the password. Sign in with the new password, or use account recovery.
auth_security_password_retry_unavailable: Current Security advice does not allow a retry. This page has kept the original request, but it will not send it without current native authorization.
auth_security_password_stage_unknown: Auth did not confirm whether it staged this password. The exact request is held on this page. Retry only this step while current Security advice allows it; no password change is confirmed yet.
auth_security_readback_unavailable: Current security settings could not be verified. The action result remains unresolved. Try checking again.
auth_security_sessions_failed: Your sessions could not be loaded. Please try again later.
auth_security_sign_in_required: You are signed out. Sign in to manage your security settings.
auth_security_target_absent: The selected item is absent from the current security inventory.
auth_security_target_present: The selected item is still in the current security inventory. You can check again or confirm another attempt.
auth_signup_already_signed_in: You are already signed in. Continue to the page you came from, or sign in with a different account.
auth_signup_conflict: We could not create this account. Sign in or recover access.
auth_signup_created: Your account was created. Sign in to continue.
auth_signup_departure_description: Your entered details will be cleared. Leaving cannot undo an account creation already submitted.
auth_signup_denied: Check the handle, email, password and verification, then try again.
auth_signup_email_requirement: Use an email address up to {maximum} characters.
auth_signup_handle_correction_action: Use this handle with a new request
auth_signup_handle_correction_body: This handle was refused and no account was created. Choose a different valid handle to start a new request.
auth_signup_handle_invalid: Use 3 to 64 characters: letters a–z, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number.
auth_signup_handle_requirement: Use {minimum} to {maximum} characters: letters a–z, numbers, hyphens or underscores. Start and end with a letter or number.
auth_signup_handle_unavailable: That handle is taken or reserved.
auth_signup_page_unavailable: Registration is temporarily unavailable. No account details were submitted. Try again later.
auth_signup_password_invalid: Password must be between {minimum} and {maximum} characters.
auth_signup_return_checking: Reading current Auth advice. This will not retry account creation or sign in.
auth_signup_return_created_body: Account creation was confirmed, but automatic sign-in did not establish a current session. Sign in or recover access.
auth_signup_return_current_session: A current account is signed in. This describes the current session; it does not show whether the earlier registration completed or which account it created.
auth_signup_return_new_attempt: This is a new registration attempt. Reviewing this page did not establish whether the earlier account creation completed.
auth_signup_return_new_attempt_created: This is a new registration attempt. The earlier account creation was confirmed; this review did not confirm a current sign-in.
auth_signup_return_unavailable_body: Auth could not provide current registration advice. The earlier result remains as described. Retry this read, sign in, or recover access.
auth_signup_return_unknown_body: The earlier request may have created an account. Current account, handle or email details cannot tell us whether it did. Sign in or recover access, or review current registration advice before starting a new attempt.
auth_signup_return_unknown_heading: Your earlier account creation may have completed
auth_signup_return_viewer_changed: The signed-in account changed during this review. This is current session information and does not resolve the earlier registration.
auth_signup_signing_in: Your account was created. Signing in…
auth_signup_retry_refused: This retry was refused, but it does not resolve the earlier attempt. Retry only the original request, or sign in or recover access.
auth_signup_retry_verification_failed: The new security check was refused. Your original account creation may still have completed. Retry only the original attempt, or sign in or recover access.
auth_signup_turnstile_failed: The security check could not load or has stopped. Please try again.
auth_signup_turnstile_required: Complete the security check before creating your account.
auth_signup_uncertain_body: Account creation may have completed for the handle and email shown below. Retry only this same attempt after a fresh security check. If you do not want to retry, sign in or recover access. Your password is never shown here.
auth_signup_uncertain_title: We could not confirm whether your account was created.
auth_signup_verification_failed: The security check was not accepted. This request did not create an account. Complete a new check and try again.
auth_step_up_departure_description: Leaving clears values entered here. Browser prompts are stopped where possible; a sign-in already sent continues in the background.
auth_step_up_explanation: Your session is not recent enough for this request, so enter your email and password to continue.
auth_step_up_continuation_changed: Authentication succeeded, but the saved request changed or was removed. Return to the action and review it again. No action was sent.
auth_step_up_review_required: After authentication, review the pending action and confirm it again. Authentication does not send the action.
auth_step_up_account_changed: Authentication finished, but the required account session is no longer current. Return to the action and restart verification.
auth_step_up_return_acknowledged: Auth accepted a sign-in request. Review current advice before continuing.
auth_step_up_return_no_continue: Current advice cannot confirm this continuation. You can choose a new identity confirmation.
auth_step_up_return_pending: Checking current advice and the saved continuation…
auth_step_up_return_ready: Current advice allows you to continue deliberately.
auth_step_up_return_refused: Auth refused the last sign-in request. No account action was sent.
auth_step_up_return_unknown: A sign-in request may have reached Auth. Its result is unknown; this page will not repeat it.
auth_step_up_return_unsent: No sign-in request was sent. You can start again after current advice is checked.
auth_transfer_accepted: Destination acceptance recorded. Send this opaque reference to the source manager with the same transfer request. Acceptance alone does not transfer the account.
auth_transfer_account_changed: The current account does not match this transfer continuation, or the saved continuation cannot be read. This page cannot submit it.
auth_transfer_confirm_destination: I confirm this exact account, current operator, version and destination, and accept responsibility as destination manager.
auth_transfer_confirm_source: I confirm this exact account, current operator, version and destination, and want to submit the transfer using the destination acceptance.
auth_transfer_conflict: The source relationship, version, or destination conflicts with this handoff. The saved tuple and operation key stay unchanged; ask the source manager for a new request.
auth_transfer_continue_source: Continue as source manager (requires source authority)
auth_transfer_acknowledged: Auth acknowledged the source transfer operation. This does not confirm the current operator relationship.
auth_transfer_current_unavailable: The operation was acknowledged, but the current operator relationship could not be independently verified. Retry this read or return to management.
auth_transfer_imported_request_provenanc: The source operator, operated account, version, and proposed destination shown here came from the imported request file. The source relationship has not been checked live.
auth_transfer_native_advice_source: Native advice allows this session to request a transfer from the current operator. It does not approve or execute the handoff.
auth_transfer_native_advice_destination: Native advice allows this session to enter acceptance for the proposed destination. It does not approve the source or prove the transfer can commit.
auth_transfer_denied: Current native authority refused this step. The destination manager needs management authority on the destination; the source manager needs management authority on the current operator. A copied reference grants no authority.
auth_transfer_destination_heading: Destination manager: review and accept first
auth_transfer_explanation: First, send the exact transfer request to the destination manager. They must review and accept it. Then the source manager must review the same request and explicitly submit the transfer with that acceptance. Each person needs current management authority on their side.
auth_transfer_guide_file_formats: Use the original request JSON file or plain-text acceptance file, encoded as UTF-8.
auth_transfer_guide_orientation: Prepare a request as the current operator, or open a request file as the proposed operator.
auth_transfer_handoff_acceptance_loaded: Acceptance file loaded locally for this saved request. Review and confirm before submitting. REZICS will check that the response belongs to this exact request and that you still have permission.
auth_transfer_handoff_consequences: Check all three account IDs independently. Accepting records the proposed operator’s agreement to take responsibility. Submitting asks REZICS to transfer management after checking both sides’ current permissions. The transfer invalidates existing sessions and approvals for the old relationship, and copies no operator permissions. A current relationship read alone does not confirm release of responsibility.
auth_transfer_handoff_download_failed: The file could not be downloaded. Try the download again or use the technical details.
auth_transfer_handoff_downloaded: Download requested. Send the file through a channel you trust; downloading does not approve or complete the transfer.
auth_transfer_handoff_explanation: Transfer management of an automated account from its current operator to a proposed operator. An operator is the person or organization responsible for that account.
auth_transfer_handoff_file_help: Select one local file of at most 4096 bytes. Files only carry a request or response; they do not verify anyone’s identity, target or authority. Selecting or downloading a file never approves or submits.
auth_transfer_handoff_import_response: Select the acceptance file returned by the proposed operator. It stays attached to this request and its original operation key.
auth_transfer_handoff_invalid_acceptance: This is not a valid acceptance response. Select the original plain-text acceptance file, without editing it.
auth_transfer_handoff_invalid_request: This is not a valid transfer request. Select the original request file, without editing it.
auth_transfer_handoff_one_file: Select exactly one file. Your existing request and operation are unchanged.
auth_transfer_handoff_preserved: The saved request, response and operation are retained. A submitted, accepted or uncertain attempt cannot be replaced here. Continue with the same request.
auth_transfer_handoff_request_loaded: Request file loaded locally. Choose Review to check the current relationship; no acceptance has been given.
auth_transfer_handoff_send_heading: Current operator: send request and submit response
auth_transfer_handoff_send_request: Send this request file to the proposed operator. Keep this page’s saved request for their response.
auth_transfer_handoff_step_accept: Proposed operator: select the request file, review its source details as file information, then use native advice for your destination action and explicitly confirm acceptance. Download the acceptance file and send it back.
auth_transfer_handoff_step_readback: Read the current relationship with your own authorization to observe the result. Acceptance alone does not complete a transfer or release responsibility.
auth_transfer_handoff_step_request: Current operator: prepare a request, download it and send the file to the proposed operator through a channel you trust.
auth_transfer_handoff_step_submit: Current operator: return to this saved request, select the acceptance file, review the account IDs, then confirm and submit the transfer.
auth_transfer_handoff_too_large: This file exceeds 4096 bytes. Your existing request and operation are unchanged.
auth_transfer_handoff_unreadable: This file could not be read as UTF-8 text. Your existing request and operation are unchanged.
auth_transfer_invalid: Use the exact transfer request and opaque acceptance reference. Extra fields, changed tuples and invalid destinations cannot be submitted.
auth_transfer_observed: The current relationship read shows the destination operator. This read does not certify final responsibility cleanup.
auth_transfer_prepare: Read current relationship and prepare request
auth_transfer_reconfirm: The saved account, request, operation key and references are retained. Review them and confirm again; returning never submits automatically.
auth_transfer_recovery_acknowledged: The source operation was acknowledged, but the current relationship readback has not confirmed its result.
auth_transfer_recovery_authority: Current authority is unavailable. Private transfer details and actions are hidden. This does not cancel or settle the saved operation.
auth_transfer_recovery_destination: The destination accepted this handoff. That acceptance does not execute or confirm the source transfer.
auth_transfer_recovery_observed: This is a current relationship observation only. It does not attribute the result to the earlier operation.
auth_transfer_recovery_pending: Reading current transfer information. The earlier outcome remains unresolved.
auth_transfer_recovery_readback_changed: The current relationship differs from the expected result. The acknowledgement remains, but this does not prove the transfer failed.
auth_transfer_recovery_saved: A saved transfer step needs fresh review. No transfer result has been inferred.
auth_transfer_recovery_source_unknown: The source transfer may have reached native, but its outcome is unknown. A matching relationship does not prove this operation completed.
auth_transfer_recovery_unavailable: Current transfer information is unavailable. No relationship or permission was inferred.
auth_transfer_recovery_unreadable: The saved transfer details cannot be reviewed. They remain untouched, and no replacement transfer is available.
auth_transfer_request: Transfer request (share with the destination manager)
auth_transfer_review_same_person: Review this request as destination manager
auth_transfer_step_up: Verify the same initiating account with the management profile to continue. You must then review and explicitly confirm again.
auth_transfer_unavailable: Native transfer review is unavailable. No relationship or permission was inferred. A submitted operation still needs separate current-state readback.
auth_transfer_uncertain: The outcome is uncertain. Keep this exact request, operation key and references. Read the current relationship or explicitly retry the same step. Responsibility release is not confirmed.
auth_automated_intro: Create an actor with a public operator marker. Enter the exact operator account ID and a new handle. No actor sign-in is created here.
auth_automated_authority: Current native account management authority is checked on the selected operator. Its grants are not copied to the actor.
auth_automated_confirm_check: I confirm this exact operator and handle. Retry only this same creation if its response is lost.
auth_automated_step_up: Verify the same human with the management profile, then review and explicitly confirm creation again.
auth_automated_refused: Creation was refused. Check the initiating account and current authority. Keep the same creation if an earlier response was lost.
auth_automated_unknown: The result is uncertain. Review and explicitly retry the same operator, handle and operation key. No new creation has been prepared.
auth_automated_unavailable: The operator or account management service is unavailable. An authenticated native management read is required to review the operator.
auth_automated_created: The native creation workflow returned account {account}.
auth_automated_result: This is the creation result. Current public identity and management state require their own authorized read.
auth_opening_intro: Switch to an operated identity. This replaces your current browser session with the selected automated actor. Your human credentials and operator grants are not copied.
auth_opening_consequences: This replaces your current browser session with a session for the operated actor. The session uses that actor's own permissions; your human credentials and the operator's permissions are not copied.
auth_opening_confirm: I approve switching to this operated identity through this operator.
auth_opening_step_up: Sign in again as the same human with the opening profile, then review and confirm again.
auth_opening_refused: Opening refused. Your current identity, selected accounts or approval no longer match.
auth_opening_unavailable: Current authorized account details are unavailable. Opening is disabled.
auth_opening_unknown: The opening result is unknown. Check the current session. Another opening requires a fresh human sign-in and new confirmation.
auth_opening_restart: Sign in again for a new opening
auth_opening_return_review: A review was underway. No session opening request was sent.
auth_opening_return_approval: Preflight or approval was underway. No session opening request was sent.
auth_opening_return_possible: A session opening request may have reached the server. Its outcome is still unknown.
auth_opening_return_acknowledged: The native response to the opening acknowledged the request.
auth_opening_return_unknown: The request outcome remains unconfirmed. A current session readback cannot show which request created a session.
auth_opening_return_refused: The opening was refused. This response does not resend or cancel another request.
auth_opening_readback_note: This is only the current session. It does not prove that the earlier request created it.
auth_opening_response_note: The native response to this opening confirmed the session.
auth_opening_departure_uncertain: The server may continue processing this opening after you leave. A later current session check cannot show which request created a session.
auth_account_identity_checking: Checking which account is signed in.
auth_account_identity_missing: This account has no login email to display.
auth_account_identity_security_target: Security changes on this page affect {account}.
auth_transfer_departure_description: Your unsent transfer preparation and review will be discarded.
auth_security_passkeys_browser_unavailab: This browser cannot create passkeys. You can still review and remove your saved passkeys.
auth_security_inventory_truncated: Some sessions or passkeys may not be shown. Refresh the list after making changes.
auth_security_step_up_advice: Confirm your identity again to continue.
auth_security_passkey_capacity: You have reached the limit of 32 passkeys. Remove one before adding another.
auth_account_delete_authentication_requi: Authenticate to review this account and its current deletion permission. Returning here never deletes the account.
auth_account_delete_advice_available: Current permission allows a deletion request. Prerequisites and permission are checked again when you submit.
auth_account_delete_review_changed: Your account or session changed. Reload the review and confirm again.
auth_account_delete_submit_requirements: Submission also checks temporary holds and pending native work. This review does not verify that they are clear.
auth_account_delete_retention_limits: Required retained records follow their adopted retention exceptions. Backup expiry and external copies are separate; this page cannot confirm their erasure.
auth_organization_delete_authentication_: Authenticate to review this selection. The selected ID is unverified; the organization’s identity, your permission and deletion requirements are available only after authorization.
auth_organization_delete_advice: This review observes current permission; it does not grant deletion or verify that all requirements are satisfied. Confirmation checks fresh authentication and current requirements again.
auth_security_current_consequence: This is your current device. Revoking this session signs you out here and requires sign-in again.
auth_security_session_consequence: Revoking this session signs that device out.
auth_security_passkey_removal_rule: Auth refuses removal if this is your last sign-in credential.
auth_security_retry_explanation: This confirmation sends a new command for this exact item. Current presence does not resolve the earlier outcome.
auth_security_target_checking: Checking current status. No removal command is sent.
auth_security_target_incomplete: This item is missing from a limited inventory window. Its absence cannot be verified. Check current status again explicitly.
auth_security_session_unknown: The session sign-out result is unknown. Check current status before reviewing another attempt.
auth_security_passkey_unknown: The passkey removal result is unknown. Check current status before reviewing another attempt.
auth_security_session_present: This session is currently present. Review its current advice before another attempt.
auth_security_passkey_present: This passkey is currently present. Review its current advice before another attempt.
auth_security_session_absent: This session is absent from the complete current inventory. This does not establish what the earlier command did.
auth_security_passkey_absent: This passkey is absent from the complete current inventory. This does not establish what the earlier command did.
auth_security_target_historical: Previously shown details. Check current status before another attempt.
auth_security_target_return_unknown: A security request may have been sent, but its result is unknown. Review current security state or sign in again; this page will not send it again automatically.
auth_security_target_return_acknowledged: Auth acknowledged a security request. Current inventory is a separate observation.
auth_security_target_return_refused: Auth refused a security request. No removal is confirmed.
auth_security_target_return_dismiss_help: Dismissing this notice changes only its presentation; it does not cancel or confirm a native action.
auth_account_delete_approval_pending: Checking whether this deletion request can proceed…
auth_account_delete_recovery_description: The earlier deletion request may have completed. Refreshing the review checks current availability and does not send a deletion. If the current review permits it, you can deliberately confirm the same request again by typing the phrase.
auth_account_delete_recovery_precision: Only a saved submitted hint is available after returning. This page cannot tell which phase ran.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_not_st: Current review has not been read yet. Checking now sends no deletion command.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_denied: Current deletion review was denied. Private details and deletion controls are unavailable.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_hidden: The organization is hidden from the current viewer. Its deletion status is not inferred.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_missin: The organization is not present in current review. Its absence does not establish whether an earlier request completed.
auth_organization_delete_return_unsent: The earlier attempt stopped before a deletion request was sent. Review the current organization before confirming another action.
auth_organization_delete_return_acknowle: Auth confirmed the organization deletion request. This does not confirm financial deletion, retained-record handling or cleanup completion.
auth_organization_delete_return_refused: The current native response refused this attempt. It does not change a separate unresolved request.
auth_organization_delete_return_review_r: Current organization details are hidden until you deliberately review them again.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_fence: Another deletion is unavailable while this earlier request remains unresolved. Refreshing review information cannot approve, repeat or settle it.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_pendin: Reading current review information. The earlier deletion outcome remains unknown.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_authen: Sign in to read current review information. No private organization information is available here. Signing in does not settle or repeat the earlier deletion.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_refuse: The organization is missing or review is currently refused. Private information and deletion controls are unavailable. This does not tell us what happened to the earlier request.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_change: The account, organization or request changed. Private information and deletion controls have been retired. The earlier deletion outcome remains unknown.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_unavai: Current review information is unavailable. A browser timeout does not cancel server work or establish the earlier deletion outcome. You may deliberately check again.
auth_organization_delete_recovery_depart: The earlier deletion outcome will remain unknown if you leave. Leaving or losing browser storage cannot cancel work already sent to the server.
auth_security_passkey_account_changed: The account changed while a passkey result was unresolved. This account’s passkeys are not linked to that registration.
auth_security_passkey_name_help: If you leave this blank, Auth suggests a label based on this browser and system; it may not identify the passkey you save.
auth_security_passkey_prompt_pending: Choose a passkey in your browser, or dismiss the prompt to cancel before anything is saved.
auth_security_passkey_registration_cance: No passkey was saved because the browser prompt was cancelled before registration was sent.
auth_security_passkey_registration_check: Checking current passkeys. This cannot confirm whether the earlier registration was saved.
auth_security_passkey_registration_confi: Auth confirmed the registration. Refreshing current passkeys and permissions before controls return.
auth_security_passkey_registration_revie: You reviewed the current passkeys. This does not confirm whether the earlier registration succeeded.
auth_security_passkey_registration_savin: The browser sent the registration. Auth may have saved the passkey; waiting for its response.
auth_security_passkey_authority_retired: The earlier passkey result remains unresolved, but this page can no longer check it for the previous account.
auth_route_failure_body: Try loading this page again. If you just submitted an account action, review its result on the page that owns it before trying again.
auth_route_failure_failed_body: The page could not be restored. A recent account action may still need review before you decide what to do next.
auth_route_failure_retry_failed: The page still could not be shown after retrying.
auth_route_missing_body: This address doesn't match an available Auth page.
auth_consent_history_unknown: An earlier approval result is unknown and may have taken effect. A current permissions review cannot resolve that result.
auth_consent_history_acknowledged: An approval was acknowledged. That acknowledgement does not establish the permissions available now.
auth_consent_history_next: Review current permissions without sending a decision, or go to Security. Leaving cannot undo a submitted approval.
auth_consent_sending: Sending approval… The result has not been acknowledged.
auth_consent_departure_description: An approval may still take effect after you leave. Leaving does not cancel it or resolve an unknown result. Stay to review current permissions, or leave this page.
auth_rename_acknowledged: The original rename was acknowledged. Its current handle could not be confirmed. Review the current account.
auth_rename_observation: The current handle is an observation. It does not confirm the outcome of the earlier rename.
auth_automated_operator_invalid: Enter a complete operator account ID (UUID).
auth_automated_responsibility: The operator will be publicly identified as responsible for this actor. Creation adds no actor sign-in or inherited grants; changing the operator requires its own authorized action.
auth_login_return_unsent: Passkey options were being prepared. No authentication response was sent. Choose a method using the current advice.
auth_login_return_prompt: The browser was waiting for a passkey. That prompt has been retired without sending authentication. Choose a method again when ready.
auth_login_return_acknowledged: Authentication was acknowledged before this page left. Review the current session to decide how to continue.
auth_login_return_refused: The earlier authentication was refused. Use the current advice to choose your next step.
auth_login_return_separate: The account shown now is a separate current observation. It cannot confirm or cancel an earlier unconfirmed sign-in.
auth_login_return_dismiss_help: Dismissal only hides this notice. It does not resolve or cancel the earlier authentication.
auth_login_prompt_cancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled before authentication was sent. Choose password or press the passkey button when ready.
auth_security_passkey_history_acknowledg: Auth confirmed this passkey registration earlier. This acknowledgement does not show whether the passkey is active now.
auth_security_passkey_history_unknown: Auth may have received this passkey registration, but the result is unknown. Check current passkeys before continuing.
auth_account_delete_return_unsent: The earlier review did not send a deletion command.
auth_account_delete_return_unknown: A deletion command may have reached the server. Its result is still unknown; current account advice cannot settle it.
auth_account_delete_return_acknowledged: The deletion request was accepted. Cleanup remains pending, so complete erasure is not confirmed.
auth_home_identity_note: These private details are for orientation only. An email or account ID does not establish permission, a human account or an operator.
auth_home_accounts_description: Review creation of a separate account. This home does not prepare a request or establish your eligibility.
auth_home_organization_description: An organization is a separate account identity with no sign-in of its own. Prepare a handle and review it deliberately; current native authentication and creation checks apply on the destination.
auth_home_automated_description: Prepare an exact operator account ID and a handle. The destination requires a current authenticated human and checks management authority on that operator before explicit review and confirmation. This does not create an actor sign-in or copy operator grants.
auth_home_selection_heading: Tasks that need an exact target
auth_home_selection_description: Select the target in its owning directory or initiating flow. No directory entry is available here. A public profile or handle is not a management selector; this home cannot choose a target for you.
auth_home_members_description: Start with the exact organization selected in its owning flow. Review the member and requested change there; current authentication and native permission checks still apply.
auth_home_organization_delete_descriptio: Start with the exact organization ID from its owning flow. Review obligations and current requirements before confirming deletion. An uncertain result or lost access does not establish completed deletion or cleanup.
auth_home_transfer_description: Use the exact actor, current operator and destination from the initiating transfer flow. The destination manager reviews and accepts the request; the source manager then reviews the same request and explicitly submits it. Each side needs current authority.
auth_home_transfer_exit: Review Security before an operator transfer
auth_home_opening_description: Use the exact automated actor and its current operator in the session-opening flow. A current authenticated human and native authority checks are required. Confirm carefully: opening replaces your browser session; human credentials and operator grants are not copied.
auth_members_return_unsent: This review ended before the change was sent. Review current membership to start again.
auth_members_return_refused: The native service refused this attempt. This does not resolve an earlier unknown request.
auth_members_return_boundary: History is separate from current membership. Dismissing it only hides this text; it does not cancel work or authorize a retry.
